cache UTF-8: three two-MiB ASCII texts retain six MiB

cache LRU: valid promotion selects deterministic eviction under byte pressure
cache expiry: a fresh hit removes an unrelated entry at the TTL boundary
cache expiry: a miss removes all unrelated stale entries before admission

source_semantic_review.fixed_policy: 32entries/8MiB UTF8 text/600000ms TTL; no timer, configurable policy or dependency.
source_semantic_review.age_and_weight: Number.isFinite(now/at/age), age>=0 and<600000; primitive text; Buffer.byteLength UTF8 with per-entry cap. Lookup sweeps every retained entry, removes invalid/stale/future/over-cap text and evicts oldest keys until both budgets fit before selecting a hit.
source_semantic_review.LRU: Normal Map inspection does not promote; controlled lookup delete+set promotes the existing identity, valid admission replaces its prior identity once and evicts least-recent keys before insertion.
source_semantic_review.replacement_and_accounting: No trusted byte counter: scan computes weights; delete/clear naturally release budget, replacement subtracts its old retained weight; UTF8 ASCII/BMP/supplementary tests cover independent cardinality/byte pressure/exactcap/+1.
source_semantic_review.unusable_admission: Nonfinite/nonnumeric at refuses retention before replacement. A validated server value remains returned even when retention is refused. Invalid lookup clocks prevent hits and remove unusable evidence.
source_semantic_review.concurrent_identity: Server unchanged identity comparison only deletes the exact failed cache hit. Late fetch/HTTP/body/abort/malformed JSON paths neither delete nor overwrite a healthy newer identity; JSON validation and deadline check precede admission.
source_semantic_review.compatibility: createSession arguments/object keys retained, new cache is a Map subclass with supported get/has/iteration/set/delete/clear. Package/version/deps/locks/default6/schemas/output functions/old47 fixtures protected.
source_semantic_review.finite_meaningful_fixtures: Read all35 named test bodies; finite payload guard<=12MiB, injected native Response/ReadableStream/AbortSignal plus hidden-fetch negative guard and positive requests/counts/identities. Existing wildcard registration only; no root/package/workflow edit.
source_semantic_review.documented_mutation_boundary: Between-operation direct entry-field mutation is remeasured at controlled operations. Replacing cache/bypassing set/accessor or during-operation mutation unsupported and disclosed; raw Map inspection is not a retention hit.
source_semantic_review.limits: Retained text only; no transport allocation, JS/object/parsed/returned value/session count/process-memory or preemptive wall-time/hosted latency/token/cost guarantee.
